    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n

{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hn : n = 1
    · simpa [hn] using h.1
    · have hne : n ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        apply hn
        simpa [hz]
      let p := n.minFac
      have hpprime : Nat.Prime p := Nat.minFac_prime hne
      have hmem : p ∈ n.primeFactors := Nat.minFac_mem_primeFactors hne
      have hnotunit : ¬ IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := ZMod.not_isUnit_of_mem_primeFactors hmem
      have hunit : IsUnit (p : ZMod n) := by
        by_cases hz : (p : ZMod n) = 0
        · have := h.1 (p : ZMod n)
          simpa [hz] using this
        · exact h.3 p hz
      exact (hnotunit hunit).elim
  · intro hp
    letI : Fact (Nat.Prime n) := ⟨hp⟩
    infer_instance"}

theorem fatem_019_zmod_isField_iff_prime (n : ℕ) :
    IsField (ZMod n) ↔ Nat.Prime n := by
